arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-final-main-20261031.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/project"
cd "$tmp/project"
expected=dfccac1613b6217e94236b008a5a42f15d8dca83
actual="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'REAL_MAIN_SHA=%s\n' "$actual"
test "$actual" = "$expected"
python3 -m codex.runtime_sync
echo MAIN_PREFLIGHT=PASS
echo MAIN_SECURITY_REGRESSIONS
python3 -m unittest discover -s codex/tests -p 'test_*.py' -q
echo MAIN_CODEX_TESTS=PASS
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' -q
echo MAIN_CONTROL_TESTS=PASS
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
echo MAIN_FINAL_CLEAN=PASS
echo MAIN_FINAL_AUDIT=PASS
